scope: Download only; no OLMo loading, generation or training.
restart_steps: Wait for the parent to provide a newly verified personal Vast instance and current endpoint. Do not resume, rent, stop, or delete provider resources from this subagent.
Verify account345874 ownership, active running state, frozen machine/GPU/disk/rate, and pinned host key. Never use the old alias or silently accept a changed host key.
Run a bounded route check while the container stays running, separating connection/redirect setup from payload speed. Reject an unusable route before committing substantial download time.
Ensure simultaneous Qwen and OLMo downloads plus environment fit the disk, with at least8GB free after both complete. OLMo alone requires64.616GB.
Use the exact17-file pinned manifest. The base is cf8741152cab0601532bfcb8fe9bdb3155f6a933; the adapter is79099b3c4dc358e0564574f9dd83c5cd2e5e60ac.

On a new host start a fresh download. The four verified tiny files may be re-fetched; do not treat the67MB partial first shard as a valid weight file. Moving it from the stopped host is unlikely to save meaningful time.
Start scripts/download_olmo32b.py detached using the new bootstrap environment, public no-token access,2workers,Xet high-performance,0chunk cache and512MiBshard cache.
Preserve first-host interruption/probe records separately. Make SSH monitoring tolerant of transient errors and consult provider state before concluding the download has failed.
Accept verified_complete only after all17 files match exact sizes/SHA256 values, both base shards and adapter have BF16 tensor metadata, and the adapter base identity matches.
Collect and publicly back up the full verification record before compute stops. Retain downloaded weights for the later user-authorized OLMo test; do not run OLMo now.
future_runtime_note: OLMo3 needs an OLMo3-compatible inference runtime; the old Qwen vLLM0.8.5/transformers4.51 environment is not a confirmed compatible runtime.
